verses.original: Γίνεσθε οὖν μιμηταὶ τοῦ Θεοῦ ὡς τέκνα ἀγαπητά
verses.transliteration: Ginesthe oun mimētai tou Theou hōs tekna agapēta
verses.literal: Be imitators of God therefore as beloved children

verses.original: καὶ περιπατεῖτε ἐν ἀγάπῃ καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς ἠγάπησεν ἡμᾶς καὶ παρέδωκεν ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν προσφορὰν καὶ θυσίαν τῷ Θεῷ εἰς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας
verses.transliteration: kai peripateite en agapē kathōs kai ho Christos ēgapēsen hēmas kai paredōken heauton hyper hēmōn prosphoran kai thysian tō Theō eis osmēn euōdias
verses.literal: and walk in love just as . . . Christ loved us and gave Himself up . . . for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God

verses.original: Πορνεία δὲ καὶ ἀκαθαρσία πᾶσα ἢ πλεονεξία μηδὲ ὀνομαζέσθω ἐν ὑμῖν καθὼς πρέπει ἁγίοις
verses.transliteration: Porneia de kai akatharsia pasa ē pleonexia mēde onomazesthō en hymin kathōs prepei hagiois
verses.literal: But among you as is proper among the saints there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality or of any kind of impurity or of greed

verses.original: καὶ αἰσχρότης καὶ μωρολογία ἢ εὐτραπελία ἃ οὐκ ἀνῆκεν ἀλλὰ μᾶλλον εὐχαριστία
verses.transliteration: kai aischrotēs kai mōrologia ē eutrapelia ha ouk anēken alla mallon eucharistia
verses.literal: Nor should there be obscenity foolish talk or crude joking which are out of character but rather thanksgiving

verses.original: τοῦτο γὰρ ἴστε γινώσκοντες ὅτι πᾶς πόρνος ἢ ἀκάθαρτος ἢ πλεονέκτης ὅ ἐστιν εἰδωλολάτρης οὐκ ἔχει κληρονομίαν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: touto gar iste ginōskontes hoti pas pornos ē akathartos ē pleonektēs ho estin eidōlolatrēs ouk echei klēronomian en tē basileia tou Christou kai Theou
verses.literal: For of this you can be sure No immoral impure or greedy person (that is an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God

verses.original: Μηδεὶς ὑμᾶς ἀπατάτω κενοῖς λόγοις διὰ ταῦτα γὰρ ἔρχεται ἡ ὀργὴ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῆς ἀπειθείας
verses.transliteration: Mēdeis hymas apatatō kenois logois dia tauta gar erchetai hē orgē tou Theou epi tous huious tēs apeitheias
verses.literal: Let no one deceive you with empty words for because of such things the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience

verses.original: μὴ οὖν γίνεσθε συμμέτοχοι αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: mē oun ginesthe symmetochoi autōn
verses.literal: Therefore do not be partakers with them

verses.original: Ἦτε γάρ ποτε σκότος νῦν δὲ φῶς ἐν Κυρίῳ ὡς τέκνα φωτὸς περιπατεῖτε
verses.transliteration: Ēte gar pote skotos nyn de phōs en Kyriō hōs tekna phōtos peripateite
verses.literal: For you were once darkness but now you are light in the Lord Walk as children of light

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ καρπὸς τοῦ φωτὸς ἐν πάσῃ ἀγαθωσύνῃ καὶ δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ἀληθείᾳ
verses.transliteration: ho gar karpos tou phōtos en pasē agathōsynē kai dikaiosynē kai alētheia
verses.literal: for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness righteousness and truth

verses.original: δοκιμάζοντες τί ἐστιν εὐάρεστον τῷ Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: dokimazontes ti estin euareston tō Kyriō
verses.literal: Test and prove what pleases the Lord

verses.original: Καὶ μὴ συνκοινωνεῖτε τοῖς ἔργοις τοῖς ἀκάρποις τοῦ σκότους μᾶλλον δὲ καὶ ἐλέγχετε
verses.transliteration: Kai mē synkoinōneite tois ergois tois akarpois tou skotous mallon de kai elenchete
verses.literal: Have no fellowship with the fruitless deeds of darkness but . . . rather expose them

verses.original: τὰ γὰρ κρυφῇ γινόμενα ὑπ’ αὐτῶν αἰσχρόν ἐστιν καὶ λέγειν
verses.transliteration: ta gar kryphē ginomena hyp’ autōn aischron estin kai legein
verses.literal: For it is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do . . . . . . in secret

verses.original: τὰ δὲ πάντα ἐλεγχόμενα ὑπὸ τοῦ φωτὸς φανεροῦται πᾶν γὰρ τὸ φανερούμενον φῶς ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: ta de panta elenchomena hypo tou phōtos phaneroutai pan gar to phaneroumenon phōs estin
verses.literal: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible for everything that is illuminated becomes a light itself

verses.original: διὸ λέγει Ἔγειρε ὁ καθεύδων καὶ ἀνάστα ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν καὶ ἐπιφαύσει σοι ὁ Χριστός
verses.transliteration: dio legei Egeire ho katheudōn kai anasta ek tōn nekrōn kai epiphausei soi ho Christos
verses.literal: So it is said Wake up O sleeper rise up from the dead and Christ will shine on you

verses.original: Βλέπετε οὖν ἀκριβῶς πῶς περιπατεῖτε μὴ ὡς ἄσοφοι ἀλλ’ ὡς σοφοί
verses.transliteration: Blepete oun akribōs pōs peripateite mē hōs asophoi all’ hōs sophoi
verses.literal: Pay careful attention then to how you walk not as unwise but as wise

verses.original: ἐξαγοραζόμενοι τὸν καιρόν ὅτι αἱ ἡμέραι πονηραί εἰσιν
verses.transliteration: exagorazomenoi ton kairon hoti hai hēmerai ponērai eisin
verses.literal: redeeming the time because the days are evil

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο μὴ γίνεσθε ἄφρονες ἀλλὰ συνίετε τί τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: dia touto mē ginesthe aphrones alla syniete ti to thelēma tou Kyriou
verses.literal: Therefore . . . do not be foolish but understand what the Lord’s will is

verses.original: καὶ μὴ μεθύσκεσθε οἴνῳ ἐν ᾧ ἐστιν ἀσωτία ἀλλὰ πληροῦσθε ἐν Πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: kai mē methyskesthe oinō en hō estin asōtia alla plērousthe en Pneumati
verses.literal: Do not get drunk on wine which leads to reckless indiscretion Instead be filled with the Spirit

verses.original: λαλοῦντες ἑαυτοῖς ἐν ψαλμοῖς καὶ ὕμνοις καὶ ᾠδαῖς πνευματικαῖς ᾄδοντες καὶ ψάλλοντες τῇ καρδίᾳ ὑμῶν τῷ Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: lalountes heautois en psalmois kai hymnois kai ōdais pneumatikais adontes kai psallontes tē kardia hymōn tō Kyriō
verses.literal: Speak to one another with psalms hymns and spiritual songs Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord

verses.original: εὐχαριστοῦντες πάντοτε ὑπὲρ πάντων ἐν ὀνόματι τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τῷ Θεῷ καὶ Πατρί
verses.transliteration: eucharistountes pantote hyper pantōn en onomati tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou tō Theō kai Patri
verses.literal: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: Ὑποτασσόμενοι ἀλλήλοις ἐν φόβῳ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hypotassomenoi allēlois en phobō Christou
verses.literal: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ

verses.original: Αἱ γυναῖκες τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν ὡς τῷ Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Hai gynaikes tois idiois andrasin hōs tō Kyriō
verses.literal: Wives submit to your husbands as to the Lord

verses.original: ὅτι ἀνήρ ἐστιν κεφαλὴ τῆς γυναικὸς ὡς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς κεφαλὴ τῆς ἐκκλησίας αὐτὸς σωτὴρ τοῦ σώματος
verses.transliteration: hoti anēr estin kephalē tēs gynaikos hōs kai ho Christos kephalē tēs ekklēsias autos sōtēr tou sōmatos
verses.literal: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church His body of which He is the Savior

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ὡς ἡ ἐκκλησία ὑποτάσσεται τῷ Χριστῷ οὕτως καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες τοῖς ἀνδράσιν ἐν παντί
verses.transliteration: alla hōs hē ekklēsia hypotassetai tō Christō houtōs kai hai gynaikes tois andrasin en panti
verses.literal: Now as the church submits to Christ so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything

verses.original: Οἱ ἄνδρες ἀγαπᾶτε τὰς γυναῖκας καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς ἠγάπησεν τὴν ἐκκλησίαν καὶ ἑαυτὸν παρέδωκεν ὑπὲρ αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: Hoi andres agapate tas gynaikas kathōs kai ho Christos ēgapēsen tēn ekklēsian kai heauton paredōken hyper autēs
verses.literal: Husbands love your wives just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up . . . for her

verses.original: ἵνα αὐτὴν ἁγιάσῃ καθαρίσας τῷ λουτρῷ τοῦ ὕδατος ἐν ῥήματι
verses.transliteration: hina autēn hagiasē katharisas tō loutrō tou hydatos en rhēmati
verses.literal: to sanctify her cleansing her by the washing with water through the word

verses.original: ἵνα παραστήσῃ αὐτὸς ἑαυτῷ ἔνδοξον τὴν ἐκκλησίαν μὴ ἔχουσαν σπίλον ἢ ῥυτίδα ἤ τι τῶν τοιούτων ἀλλ’ ἵνα ᾖ ἁγία καὶ ἄμωμος
verses.transliteration: hina parastēsē autos heautō endoxon tēn ekklēsian mē echousan spilon ē rhytida ē ti tōn toioutōn all’ hina ē hagia kai amōmos
verses.literal: and to present her to Himself as a glorious church without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish but - holy and blameless

verses.original: Οὕτως ὀφείλουσιν καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες ἀγαπᾶν τὰς ἑαυτῶν γυναῖκας ὡς τὰ ἑαυτῶν σώματα ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γυναῖκα ἑαυτὸν ἀγαπᾷ
verses.transliteration: Houtōs opheilousin kai hoi andres agapan tas heautōn gynaikas hōs ta heautōn sōmata ho agapōn tēn heautou gynaika heauton agapa
verses.literal: In the same way . . . husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies He who loves his wife loves himself

verses.original: οὐδεὶς γάρ ποτε τὴν ἑαυτοῦ σάρκα ἐμίσησεν ἀλλὰ ἐκτρέφει καὶ θάλπει αὐτήν καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς τὴν ἐκκλησίαν
verses.transliteration: oudeis gar pote tēn heautou sarka emisēsen alla ektrephei kai thalpei autēn kathōs kai ho Christos tēn ekklēsian
verses.literal: Indeed no one ever hated his own body but he nourishes and cherishes it just as Christ does the church

verses.original: ὅτι μέλη ἐσμὲν τοῦ σώματος αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hoti melē esmen tou sōmatos autou
verses.literal: For we are members of His body

verses.original: Ἀντὶ τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ προσκολληθήσεται πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν
verses.transliteration: Anti toutou kataleipsei anthrōpos ton patera kai tēn mētera kai proskollēthēsetai pros tēn gynaika autou kai esontai hoi dyo eis sarka mian
verses.literal: For this reason . . . a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife and the two will become . . . one flesh

verses.original: τὸ μυστήριον τοῦτο μέγα ἐστίν ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω εἰς Χριστὸν καὶ εἰς τὴν ἐκκλησίαν
verses.transliteration: to mystērion touto mega estin egō de legō eis Christon kai eis tēn ekklēsian
verses.literal: This mystery is profound but I am speaking about Christ and the church

verses.original: πλὴν καὶ ὑμεῖς οἱ καθ’ ἕνα ἕκαστος τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γυναῖκα οὕτως ἀγαπάτω ὡς ἑαυτόν ἡ δὲ γυνὴ ἵνα φοβῆται τὸν ἄνδρα
verses.transliteration: plēn kai hymeis hoi kath’ hena hekastos tēn heautou gynaika houtōs agapatō hōs heauton hē de gynē hina phobētai ton andra
verses.literal: Nevertheless each one . . . . . . of you also . . . must love his wife as he loves himself and the wife must respect her husband
